purpose: Define the disaster-recovery and irreversible V1 reclaim gate. This source-only stage does not drop, truncate, rewrite, vacuum-full, or delete any production relation, dump, archive, or backup.

candidate_v1_relations.reason: link graph represented by event_entity_link_blocks_v2 plus archive-verified link details
event identity/facts represented by events_v2_core, event_facts_v2 and canonical event archives
entity identity/details represented by entities_v2 and canonical entity archives

required_live_proofs.acceptance: Fresh PostgreSQL dump and V2 archive root are copied to an independent disk or volume and SHA-256 verified after copy.
Restore uses the independent copy, verifies schema, exact counts, latest event, V2 archive manifests and smoke queries.
V2 read/write and external FK cutover have operated for the approved stability window with zero unexplained data, archive, search, report or findings mismatch.
Relation sizes are measured immediately before reclaim and projected post-drop database plus archive size still meets the accepted ratio gate.
Owner explicitly accepts that after dropping V1 identity/link relations, SQL rollback alone is impossible.

hard_stop_conditions: accepted live external FK cutover report is missing
fresh independent backup copy is missing or SHA mismatched
isolated restore from external copy is missing or failed
V2 archive restore or manifest verification failed
projected ratio after reclaim is below 2.5x
owner irreversible approval phrase is missing
requested drop list differs from exactly event_entity_links, events, observed_entities
request attempts to delete dumps, V1 archives or V2 archives
strictly_forbidden: drop, truncate, rewrite or VACUUM FULL any production relation from this source-only stage
drop finding_evidence, finding_entities, event_links, entity_states or detections
drop any V2 table or archive manifest table
delete old dumps or archives in this stage
claim SQL rollback is possible after V1 drop
perform reclaim without fresh external restore proof
perform reclaim without explicit irreversible owner approval

next_stage.purpose: Accept measured DB-storage result only after live reclaim evidence exists.
